posts.title: Five rules, one accident
posts.notes: Post the PDF as a document (swipeable).
posts.caption:
Five rules, one accident.

How everything we post is built, so it feels like one studio:

1. One grid: 72 px margins and an 8 px rhythm.
2. One typeface: Figtree, ExtraBold for headlines.
3. Whole footage: the work is never cropped or zoomed.
4. Exact numbers: real values from the sites, not adjectives.
5. One accident: a red exclamation mark, tilted 14 degrees like our logo, that lands last.

Happy accidents happen.

posts.title: Elements 06: Light and dark
posts.notes: Elements 06, a 12 s loop at 60 fps: the 9:16 reel goes to Instagram and YouTube, the 4:5 cut to LinkedIn and X. Sound is clicks and pops over our series track. Cover frame: the element mid-action, with the headline showing.
posts.caption:
Flip it!

Elements 06: Light and dark. Dark mode, flipped like a light switch.

The sun turns into a moon, stars pop into the track and the whole screen changes from the point you touched. A theme change you can follow, instead of a flash.

The values: The knob springs 240 px (stiffness 200, damping 16) and the theme spreads from it in a circle, 2300 px in 1.2 s.

Elements is our new series: one interface element at a time, the small details that make a site feel alive. Happy accidents happen.

Sort it!

Pick a row up and it lifts while the others make room. Swipe one away and the gap closes behind it. Switch to a grid and every row finds its new place on a spring.

posts.caption:
Open it!

Elements 08: Accordion. An accordion is a promise: the answer is right here, when you want it.

Open one question and the last one closes. The answer rises in line by line, so your eye knows where to start. Expand all cascades instead of jumping.

The values: Rows spring open (stiffness 150, damping 13). Lines rise 6 frames apart, and Expand all cascades 0.1 s apart.

posts.title: Elements 12: Toasts
posts.notes: Elements 12, a 12 s loop at 60 fps: the 9:16 reel goes to Instagram and YouTube, the 4:5 cut to LinkedIn and X. Sound is clicks and pops over our series track. Cover frame: the element mid-action, with the headline showing.
posts.caption:
Swipe it!

Elements 12: Toasts. Notifications shouldn't shout.

They stack, step back as new ones arrive, fan out when you hover and fly off when you swipe. When something fails, it says so, and Retry fixes it.

The values: Each new toast pushes the stack back to 94%, a hover fans it out on springs (stiffness 120), a fling tilts 1° per 50 px.
